This chapter is the configuration reference of the book: the build options that decide what is compiled, the
generated macros that fix the compiled alternatives, the numerics switches (two read from the environment, three
read from the deck), the launch variables of the layout, the test-harness variables, the YAML[^rg-602bede77d0b] keys that select the
local schemes, and the matrix that says which switch combination a registered test exercises. The mechanisms
the switches select are described where they belong, in @sec-ch04, @sec-ch05 and @sec-ch06; here each switch
section keeps its selector, its default, its couplings and guards, and the registered evidence, and points at
its home for the derivation. No solver run is reported in this chapter; the independent checks of the
chapter's contracts are the script `src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.py` with its committed output,
and the solver tests are catalogued with their assertions in @sec-ch16-ch12-tests.

At the code pin the numerics switches are written in the tables of this chapter by two-letter abbreviations.

- XC is the environment variable `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`, off by default.
- CO, FC and MC[^rg-52dc4b39bbdc] are the deck keys `dynamics/conversion-order` (default 2), `dynamics/flux-covariance`
  (default true) and `dynamics/x1-mass-covariance` (default false).
- The corrected face work has no switch; `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT` is not read.
- The fourth-order face reference has no switch of its own: it is part of CO 4, and `SNAP_WB_REF4` is not read.
- `SNAP_ANOMALY` overrides the deck key `dynamics/anomaly`.

The dependency figure below draws an implication from XC to the fourth-order reference, which the code at the pin
does not have: the two share only a three-ghost guard.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-dependencies
```
